purpose: Public native GraphCoder JSON-lines qualification for cancellation and operator approvals

runtime.fixture_policy: The blocking model is an explicit deterministic fixture. Its approval ticket is bound to the exact blocking operation identity, and its waiting state belongs to the model provider; the driver only uses public Harness-backed routes. The fixture has no model tool side effect, so approval evidence covers durable interaction routing and operation binding rather than effect authorization.

assertions: list_approvals exposes the durable ticket as pending
an incorrect operator credential is denied
the configured operator resolves the exact pending ticket and a wrong credential leaves it pending
cancel_session persists cancellation while the blocking model turn is unresolved
the cancelled start returns stale and cannot report false completion
all requests and responses remain correlated through the JSON-lines bridge
the child process closes after stdin completion and is cleaned up on driver failure

evidence.artifact_binding: The suite result must include the exact native executable digest and qualified source commit/tree.
evidence.fixture_boundary: This scenario proves Harness cancellation and approval routing with a deterministic provider; it does not prove production model quality.
